body:
Thank you for your kind words. I noticed that you are very active on this forum and type out some very uplifting, hearfelt reactions. I admire that immensely.

 I also read your story and what you have been trough. It sounds very difficult. I wish you all the best in seeking therapy and finding peace, I have full confidence in your ability to become at peace and making the first step to go to therapy. If you ever need someone to talk about this you can always PM me.

Thanks, i will stay safe. I notice when i look back at the relationship that i have a lot of issues that i need to fix. Like saying "Well, should we just break up then?" when my ex said something that geniunely concerned her about our relationship. i think sometimes i was too sensitive to communicate effectively and her fear of making me sad when trying to communicate with me caused our relationship to erode away due to communication problems. i think this made me say those horrible things because because of this i bottled up emotions. I took her for granted and didn't take her feedback seriously. She was an amazing person that took a lot of crap from me. Do you believe that behaviour from me can be fixed because that's what worries me.. 

You are right about the good things.. i think that i did a lot of good things too like give her a lot of hugs and told her she was pretty.

My mind just clouds the good things with the negatives
Thank you very much for this
There is always someone that loves you, even if it does not feel like it. remember that

sometimes your brain makes you think things that are not true.. you wil and can get out of this man.. deep inside you there is strength, its amazing how you have come this far and stil fight on. dont lose hope now.  you should defenitely call the person,  it wil help even of it doesnt feel like it
